description: Create the PCB. With auto=true the server places the parts and picks the smallest board (normal way). Costs credits. Requires a PCBBrew account (sign-in).

keep_size.description: only if the size is imposed: the reason

placement.description: {REF: {x, y, rot, side: 'F'|'B'}} mm from the board's top-left corner; x, y = footprint anchor ('origin' in the result, not 'centre')

spacing.description: auto only: mm between parts (1 normal, 1.5-2 if routing fails)

tht_back.description: only if THT parts must go on the back: the reason

name: place_pcb
title: Place parts on the PCB
